minor: Cold open and title: "735 stores emptied" / "735 Closed Stores". The sources say about 735 stores were to be closed OR sold, so "closed or sold" (as the script says later) is more exact. The 33,000 jobs and the June 29 closure are fine.

"The first crack came five years before the buyout" (the Amazon deal, 2000) sits oddly with the script's own point that Walmart had already passed Toys R Us in 1998. Say "the first self-inflicted crack" or similar.
(quote) shot: "The chief executive called it a fresh start" is a paraphrase. The sourced quote is "the dawn of a new era", and the actual line is never shown or spoken.
"A supermarket for toys" and the "priced hit toys low to pull families through the door" detail are not in the listed sources. Both are well documented but could be added to `sources`.
"After former workers campaigned" (the Nov 2018 fund) is not in the listed source. It is widely reported, but could be added to `sources`.
Macy's shops "from 2022" follows the listed source. Check the exact launch timing against the press release before publishing.
"One week later" (the founder's death) is correct: March 15 to March 22, 2018.
